create_mock_agent: create a MockAgent instance for a worker to work on a given Unit
enqueue_mock_live_update: enqueue a fake live update observation into the mock agent's pending acts queue
enqueue_mock_submit_event: enqueue a final submit event into the mock agent's pending submit queue
approve_reject_work: approve or reject work done by a mock agent with optional review notes and bonus
await_submit: await and check the submission status of a mock agent with optional timeout
